fold: <N> owes <N> a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
text: Noura al-Hakim owes Saida al-Misri a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
why: says Noura al-Hakim owes Saida al-Misri a large sum; Saida's secret says Saida owes Noura a debt, the opposite direction

fold: <N> has fallen on hard times, and the debt <N> owes is now the only asset <N> has.
text: Isaakios Bryennios has fallen on hard times, and the debt Helene Makrembolites owes is now the only asset Isaakios Bryennios has.
why: says Isaakios Bryennios, the occupying governor, has fallen on hard times with one debt his only asset; Occupation Authority takes the town's revenue

fold: <N> has asked <N> for a second favour before repaying the first.
text: Knud Svensson has asked Drifa Eriksson for a second favour before repaying the first.
why: Knud asking for a second favour before repaying the first puts him two ahead; contradicts 'neither has ever been more than one favour ahead'

fold: The friendship is warm and public, and it lasts only while that reckoning holds.
text: The friendship is warm and public, and it lasts only while that reckoning holds.
why: friendship 'warm and public' but Isidor's card wants it kept quiet, and 'neither has said so aloud'

fold: A dispute over grazing rights and water access has run for # seasons, and the families on each side no longer speak to # another.
text: A dispute over grazing rights and water access has run for two seasons, and the families on each side no longer speak to one another.
why: a two-season grazing and water dispute with families not speaking; QUARRELS is none, stability Stable, and the only live tension is the great fire

fold: In return, <N>'s people keep <N>'s carts moving on roads where other carts are stopped.
text: In return, Aischylos Strategopoulos's people keep Hieronymos Attaleiates's carts moving on roads where other carts are stopped.
why: Hieronymos's carts kept moving on roads where others are stopped; CRISIS is siege with nothing in or out by road, smuggling stopped by the siege
says seasons keep being profitable; STATE is Struggling under siege and famine, no trade comes in (C0066 says income is pre-siege only)
